create_MathEval_instance: create a MathEval instance to evaluate math problem solving on a CSV dataset
test_MathEval_call: test the MathEval class by calling it with a sampler to run evaluations on math problems
build_MathEval_equality_check: build an equality checker to compare extracted model answers against correct answers
run_MathEval_parallel: run MathEval evaluations in parallel across multiple threads on a MATH dataset CSV
summarize_MathEval_results: summarize MathEval results by aggregating per-example scores into an EvalResult
